operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:sources && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm run verify
operations.recovery: Stop the owned Auth processes before export. Follow docs/backup-and-restore.md: retain the source and private configuration, export using rer export, restore using rer import into a fresh empty installation, then verify owner sign-in, linked apps and a real re-export before routing traffic. Keep the issuer host and unchanged applied migration bytes. Active isolated employers refuse installation export and restore; do not bypass this boundary.
